from base_sensor import BaseVirtualSensor

class LM83_Simulator(BaseVirtualSensor):
    REG_WIDTH = 8

    def __init__(self):
        self.regs = {
            0x00: 0x00,  # TEMP_LOCAL
            0x01: 0x00,  # TEMP_D2
            0x02: 0x00,  # SR1
            0x03: 0x00,  # CONFIG
            0x05: 0x7F,  # LHS
            0x07: 0x7F,  # D2RHS
            0x30: 0x00,  # TEMP_D1
            0x31: 0x00,  # TEMP_D3
            0x35: 0x00,  # SR2
            0x38: 0x7F,  # D1RHS
            0x3A: 0x7F,  # D3RHS
            0x42: 0x7F,  # TCS
            0xFE: 0x01,  # MID
            0xFF: 0x00   # STEP_ID
        }

    def read_register(self, addr: int, nbytes: int = 2) -> int:
        if addr not in self.regs:
            raise ValueError(f"Invalid register address: {addr}")
        
        if nbytes == 1:
            # Single byte semantics: only bits 15:8 are returned
            return (self.regs[addr] >> 8) & 0xFF
        
        # Read the full register
        return self.regs[addr]

    def write_register(self, addr: int, data: int, nbytes: int = 2) -> None:
        if addr not in self.regs:
            raise ValueError(f"Invalid register address: {addr}")
        
        if nbytes == 1:
            # Update only bits 15:8
            self.regs[addr] &= 0x00FF
            self.regs[addr] |= (data << 8)
        else:
            # Write the full register
            self.regs[addr] = data
